display_long_description:
Where devils congregate, and where guns, luck, mind games, and chaos reign supreme. Welcome to hell's most wanted social club.
[media]

# Test Your Luck, Risk It All 
[media]
Devil’s Roulette -The Pit- is a thrilling VR party game for 1 to 4 players!

# Freely Customize 
[media]
From luxurious skins to an arsenal of guns and trinkets! Pursue your own style.


# Madness-Filled Stages
[media]
Battle across a multitude of stunning stages, each featuring unique gimmicks.


# Join the Discord!!
[media]
Check our Discord for the latest news, player interactions, free skin giveaways, and more!

https://mydearest.net/DevilsRoulette-BazookaDiscord
